senses.gloss: श्वृ r. 9th cl. (श्वृणाति) To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill.

स्वृ r. 1st cl. (-स्वरति)
 1. To sound.
 2. To be diseased.
 3. To pain or
torture.
 4. To praise. With सम् prefixed, in an intransitive sense,
the verb becomes deponent, (संस्वरते) It sounds.
स्वृ r. 9th cl. (स्वृणाति) To hurt, to kill.
